name: ns_proofsearch_gain_tax_tether
rubric_version_reason: Adds the GPT-5.5-discovered survival correction, elevates the non-local ghost as the Track B vector-ledger target, and hardens against statement-narrowing: finite or named-class theorems must not be labeled as global Leray-convexity.
description: Theorem-search substrate for the Navier-Stokes full-ledger gain/tax tether exposed by finite-support multi-background audits.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search over a proof bridge, not numerical curve fitting.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by anti-tautology, full-ledger, high-high tax, damping, and asymptotic tether gates.
symbolic_asymptotic_gate_reason: The exact residual polynomial D(t)=t^2+2bt^3+ct^4 turns gain~A and self_tax~A^2 into a constant survival burden, not a vanishing degree split.
persona: You are a ruthless Navier-Stokes theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The live proof object is not broad resupply and not mixed-only finite-stencil discovery. Multi-background mixed-only Leray crossings exist, but reconstructed eigenvectors are killed by high-high self-tax. Reward only candidates that expose a top-level full-ledger gain/tax tether theorem with mechanical asymptotic_terms(), a Leray-projected vector_ledger_terms(), or a concrete violating block that survives P(V·∇V), damping, defect, and PSD honesty. The highest-value no-go is the non-local ghost exclusion: show that the sharp gain/sqrt(self_tax) survival constant is enforced by the torus Leray symbol/tensor ledger, not by dense-slab averaging. Penalize prose-only ledgers, phase-fitting, mixed-only promotion, finite-to-infinite overclaim, theorem-narrowing overclaim, qualitative Sobolev/nonlinear-maximum-principle slogans, and unbounded computation.

dimensions.name: Independent Fourier Class
dimensions.description: Is the mode/eigenclass/generator rule defined independently of the desired margin?

dimensions.name: Mixed Gain Ledger
dimensions.description: Does the thesis correctly state and use the damped signed mixed gain channel?

dimensions.name: High-High Self-Tax Ledger
dimensions.description: Does it charge P(V·∇V) explicitly and quantitatively?

dimensions.name: Full Defect And Survival Amplitude
dimensions.description: Does it use the total residual and first-defect amplitude rather than mixed-only normalization?

dimensions.name: Duhamel And Viscous Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it pay source/output damping or justify a different lifetime tax?

dimensions.name: PSD And Signed-Coordinate Honesty
dimensions.description: Does it avoid laundering an indefinite signed coordinate into positive energy without ballast?

dimensions.name: Asymptotic Tether Or Concrete Violator
dimensions.description: Does it mechanically derive a symbolic/vector gain-tax tether with constants, or provide a full-ledger block violation?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid phases, amplitudes, or certificates chosen backward from target cancellation?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, exact falsifier, sequence law, or decisive proof-cost reranking?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Resource Safety
dimensions.description: Does it avoid Clay overclaim and keep proposed audits bounded, sparse, symbolic, or proof-facing?

criteria.Independent_Fourier_Class: Full credit requires a predeclared mode/eigenclass/generator rule independent of the desired margin.
criteria.Mixed_Gain_Ledger: Full credit requires correct use of the damped signed mixed gain channel, including the 2/3 one-background ceiling and multi-background mixed-only crossings.
criteria.High_High_Self_Tax_Ledger: Full credit requires explicit P(V·∇V) self-tax, not only residual words.
criteria.Full_Defect_And_Survival_Amplitude: Full credit requires total residual t R_mixed + t^2 R_self and first-defect amplitude or equivalent full-ledger normalization.
criteria.Duhamel_And_Viscous_Discipline: Full credit requires Duhamel/viscous lifetime payment or a rigorous reason the Phase 5EB/5EC tax is inapplicable.
criteria.PSD_And_Signed_Coordinate_Honesty: Full credit requires signed-coordinate nonclaim or PSD/ballast payment for any positive-energy statement.
criteria.Asymptotic_Tether_Or_Concrete_Violator: Full credit requires either asymptotic_terms() with an independent parametric class, gain/self-tax polynomials or symbolic bounds, cross terms, degree comparison, leading coefficients, limit, and falsifier; vector_ledger_terms() with Leray-projected tensor/vector burden; or a concrete full-ledger violating block.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Discipline: Full credit requires no backward phase/certificate fitting and no observed-budget amplifier.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a usable theorem/falsifier/no-go packet or decisive route reranking.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Resource_Safety: Reject unsupported regularity/blowup claims, unbounded dense computation proposals, and finite/bounded/named-class theorems labeled as global Leray-convexity without an explicit closure argument.

success_criteria: A symbolic/asymptotic no-go packet proving a gain-tax tether for a named independent Fourier class, with explicit asymptotic_terms().
A Leray-projected vector/tensor ledger proving the gain-tax tether for a named class, with explicit vector_ledger_terms().
A non-local ghost exclusion showing the sharp gain/sqrt(self_tax) survival constant follows from the flat-torus Leray projection/vector ledger rather than from dense-slab scaling.
A concrete full-ledger violating block with profit above 2/3 after high-high, damping, defect, and PSD/ballast accounting.
A bounded exact Fourier/CAS falsifier showing the bounded gain-tax dichotomy is an artifact and naming the next audit.
A class-specific theorem that is explicitly labeled as class-specific and states the exact missing closure needed before it could become a global Track B theorem.
failure_modes: Promoting mixed-only generalized eigen crossings without P(V·∇V).
Choosing phases, amplitudes, signs, or return subsequences by solving backward from positive margin.
Ignoring total defect or first-defect amplitude.
Ignoring Duhamel damping or viscous lifetime.
Calling an indefinite signed coordinate positive energy without ballast.
Inferring infinite-dimensional control from finite-bound strict inequalities without asymptotic_terms() or vector_ledger_terms().
Proving a finite-mode, bounded-subspace, named packet class, two-mode/triad, or dyadic-ladder statement and labeling it as the global Leray-convexity theorem.
Assuming dense support, family averages, or local triad exhaustion exclude the non-local ghost without a Leray-projected vector-ledger constant.
Asserting self_tax >= k0 * mixed_gain^2, a nonlinear maximum principle, or a Fourier/spatial uncertainty bridge without deriving the constant-bearing ledger.
Claiming Clay regularity or blowup from this middle-layer object.
Using large dense Fourier jobs, unbounded Lean builds, or the crashed exponential metric transport obstruction.
